title: Plugin Catalog Entry
description: One plugin as authored in plugins/<id>.json. Mirrors internal/plugin.CatalogEntry in nginx-ui, minus the fields the host computes at fetch time (source, installable_release, installed_version, update_available).

author_public_key.description: Minisign public key (text form) that signs plugin.sums in the packages of a community entry. Required when trust is "community".

screenshots.description: Images of the plugin in use, in display order. PNG, JPEG or WebP, about 16:10 at 1280 to 1920 pixels wide.

license.description: SPDX license identifier of the plugin's own source (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, AGPL-3.0-only).

pluginId.description: Reverse-DNS style id. com.nginxui.* is reserved for official plugins; authors without a domain use io.github.<owner>.<name>.

locale.description: BCP-47-ish locale key as used by nginx-ui's gettext catalogs, e.g. "en", "zh_CN", "zh_TW", "ja_JP".

localizedText.description: Locale code to translated string. "en" is required as the fallback nginx-ui always falls back to.

dark_url.description: The same view in the dark theme, at the size of url. Hosts show url when it is absent.

trust.description: Trust level the entry claims. official: published by the nginx-ui project. verified: published by a partner organization the maintainers vouch for, with a partner certificate in the package or a listing in the partner keyring (v1/partners.json), with no claim about source review. community: signed by the author with author_public_key. The host derives the effective level from the key that signed plugin.sums inside the package.

stage.description: Maturity label shown next to the plugin. It does not change the channel of any release.

semver.description: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0, matching internal/plugin.semverPattern in nginx-ui.

platform.description: "<goos>-<goarch>" (e.g. "linux-amd64") as Go spells them, or "any" for a platform-independent package. Matches schema/catalog.schema.json's platformKey in plugin-spec.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the archive, a download integrity check. The package signature is plugin.sums.minisig inside the archive.

download.description: One per-platform package of a release, an entry of "downloads".

release.description: A release needs at least one of download_url (the portable package) or downloads (per-platform packages); both may be present.

platforms.description: Summary of where the release installs: every key of downloads plus the platforms the portable package serves. Empty or absent means the portable package runs everywhere.

downloads.description: Per-platform packages, keyed by "<goos>-<goarch>" or "any". A host picks downloads[platform], then downloads["any"], then the portable package.

download_url.description: The portable package, the fallback for every platform downloads does not name. Optional once downloads is present.

notes.description: What changed in the release, in Markdown: the body of the GitHub Release, cut at 4096 characters. The index keeps it on the five newest releases of a plugin.

channel.description: The release channel, from the most to the least stable. Without it a host infers the channel from the version: no prerelease part is stable, a prerelease starting with alpha, dev, nightly, snapshot, canary or preview is dev, any other prerelease (beta, rc, pre) is beta. Set it only to put a plain version on a less stable channel.

manifestSnapshot.description: Snapshot of the release's plugin.json, used by the host to show permissions and capabilities before download (internal/plugin.CatalogRelease.Manifest, protocol.Manifest). Bulky sub-documents such as dns01.providers should be omitted here; the host itself only reads permissions, capabilities, requires, conflicts, api_version and min_nginx_ui_version from this snapshot.

i18n.description: Translations of name and description keyed by locale. The release workflow may fill the entry's name and description maps from it.

conflicts.description: Plugin ids that must not be enabled at the same time as this plugin.

server.description: Only server.resources is described here, the rest of the block is not read from the snapshot.

recommended_memory_mb.description: Memory in MiB the machine, or the container the host runs in, should have for the plugin to work well. Advice only, a host never refuses to install or run a plugin because of it. 0 or absent means no hint.
